name: Sderot era / Second Intifada (cumulative)
outcome_notes: Pre-Iron Dome. Mostly Qassams. Cumulative estimate; totals vary widely by source.

name: Operation Cast Lead
outcome_notes: Pre-Iron Dome. ~571 rockets + ~205 mortars per common tallies.

name: Operation Pillar of Defense
outcome_notes: First major Iron Dome use; intercepted ~421 of those it engaged. 6 civilian deaths.

name: Operation Protective Edge
outcome_notes: 4,881 rockets + 1,753 mortars (OCHA). ~875 fell short inside Gaza (UN). 6 civilians killed by rocket fire.

name: 2018-2019 escalations (cumulative)
outcome_notes: Multiple rounds incl. Nov 2018 (~460) and May 2019 (~690). Approximate.

name: Operation Guardian of the Walls
outcome_notes: ~4,360 fired; ~680 fell short inside Gaza; Iron Dome ~90% of those threatening populated areas.

name: Breaking Dawn (PIJ)
outcome_notes: PIJ-only escalation; ~200 fell short inside Gaza; no Israeli deaths.

name: Iron Swords — Oct 7 initial barrage
outcome_notes: IDF ~2,200; Hamas claimed 5,000 (range encoded as midpoint). Casualties that day dominated by the ground assault, not rockets.

name: Iron Swords — Oct 2023 to Jan 2024
outcome_notes: More than 10,600 projectiles launched; ~10% reported to have failed / fallen short.
